channels.label: F4_C4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain F4-C4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_P4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain C4-P4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: P4_O2
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain P4-O2 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to contralateral mastoid A1 is the C4_M1 derivation, and the neuro trace supports it.

channels.label: ROC_LOC
channels.reason: Bipolar ROC-LOC is a combined EOG derivation; the slow resp-like trace is consistent with slow eye movements.

channels.label: EMG1_EMG2
channels.reason: Bipolar chin EMG with a 10-80 Hz filter and an EMG-like trace.

channels.label: ECG1_ECG2
channels.reason: ECG1-ECG2 is the ECG lead per label and transducer, though the trace was classed as neuro-like.

channels.label: TIB_Sx
channels.reason: Tibialis on the left side (Italian 'Sx' = sinistro) is the left leg EMG.

channels.label: TIB_Dx
channels.reason: Tibialis on the right side (Italian 'Dx' = destro) is the right leg EMG.

channels.label: SAO2
channels.reason: Oximeter saturation in %, and the trace looks like SpO2.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Oximeter heart rate in BPM, and the trace looks like HR.

channels.label: PLETH
channels.reason: Pulse-wave plethysmogram from the oximeter, per label and the Pwave transducer.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Sound microphone channel serves as the snore signal.

channels.label: Flusso
channels.reason: Italian 'flusso' (flow) with a pressure transducer is nasal pressure, and the trace looks respiratory.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Italian 'torace' is thoracic effort, and the trace looks respiratory.

channels.label: ADDDOME
channels.reason: Italian 'addome' (misspelled ADDDOME) is abdominal effort, and the trace looks respiratory.
